title: Beyond Patching: Consistent Circuit Discovery via Gradient Spectral Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.30939v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability seeks to reverse-engineer neural networks by identifying small, faithful subgraphs--circuits--that implement specific behaviors. The dominant paradigm scores each unit by replacing its clean activation with a corrupted counterpart as causal intervention. While effective, this approach rests on a brittle prerequisite: the structure prompt pairs are task-specific, expensive to engineer, and silently couple the discovered circuit to prompt-design choices. In this work, we propose Spectral Circuit Analysis (SCA), a gradient-spectral pipeline that achieves consistent circuit discovery along both axes: stable across input formulations of the same task, and natively exposing structure shared across tasks. Our contributions are threefold. First, we provide a counterfactual-free reframing of circuit discovery: causally relevant directions are recoverable from the spectral structure of forward gradients across paraph

translated_title: 超越修补：基于梯度谱分析的一致性电路发现
translated_abstract: 机械可解释性旨在通过识别实现特定行为的小型且忠实的子图——即“电路”——来对神经网络进行逆向工程。当前的主流范式通过将各单元的干净激活替换为损坏的对应激活作为因果干预来对每个单元进行评分。尽管有效，这种方法依赖于一个脆弱的前提：结构化提示对是任务特定的、构建成本高昂，且会悄然地将所发现的电路与提示设计的选择耦合在一起。在这项工作中，我们提出了谱电路分析（SCA）——一种基于梯度谱的分析流程，它在两个维度上实现了一致性的电路发现：在同一任务的不同输入表述之间保持稳定，并能原生地揭示跨任务共享的结构。我们的贡献有三个。首先，我们为电路发现提供了一种无反事实的重新表述：因果相关的方向可以从跨同义改写输入的前向梯度的谱结构中恢复……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出谱电路分析（SCA），通过前向梯度的谱结构实现无反事实的电路发现，使发现结果在不同输入表述下保持稳定一致，并能原生揭示跨任务共享的结构。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Spectral Circuit Analysis (SCA), a counterfactual-free circuit discovery pipeline based on the spectral structure of forward gradients, achieving consistent circuit discovery that is stable across input paraphrases while natively exposing structure shared across tasks.
